name: Dave Aranda's Tite Front & Peso Package
description: A 4i-0-4i box that eliminates both B-gaps before the snap, forcing spread runs to bounce into walked-down hybrid defenders. Peso nickel/dime personnel blur the line between back-end and box — apex linebackers split the #2-receiver-to-tackle lines, split-field quarters pattern-matches every slot, and three-man simulated pressures occupy the quarterback’s escape lanes with defenders who were never rushing at all.
